title: allocator-epoch-replayer-with-prefetch-fingerprint-and-ttl-consistency-checker
author: Marisol Ortega
description: Problem: intermittent OOMs and warmup regressions in long-running dedicated clusters stem from mismatch between prefetch heuristics and allocator TTL semantics; reproducing these cases deterministically for regression tests has been hard. Goal: introduce a standalone benchmark runner that replays allocator-era events as an epoch stream, synthesizes time-series memory pressure and prefetch decisions, fingerprints prefill state, and validates TTL-based eviction consistency across simulated restarts. This PR adds the runner, a TTL consistency verifier, collection hooks for the telemetry pipeline, and a compact golden dataset used for CI regression checks. What this PR does: 1) new runner (allocator_epoch_replayer) that consumes an epoch stream (timestamps, alloc/free events, prefetch intents) and drives the serving runtime's prefill hooks via a lightweight test harness; 2) prefetch fingerprinting: deterministic hash snapshots of KV prefix fills taken at epoch boundaries for diffable regressions; 3) TTL consistency checker that asserts post-restart state is equivalent modulo allowed drift windows and reports a structured delta summary; 4) CI integration with a short golden run and a long warmup nightly job; 5) docs and a README with reproduction steps and tuning knobs. Motivation: gives SRE and runtime teams an actionable, repeatable tool to catch regressions where prefetch heuristics interact badly with allocator eviction windows. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for epoch parser and fingerprinting - [x] integration harness for local runtime loopback - [x] golden dataset generation script included - [x] performance baseline and p95/p99 regression thresholds documented - [x] CI smoke job wired into benchmark-lab short-tests. Performance notes: local emulation (x8 CPU cores, single GPU mock) shows no added steady-state latency; prefill verification run completes in ~2m 40s for the golden trace; artifact size ~26KB. Risk: none to production runtime; this is a test harness and telemetry exporter only. Related: ENG-2149, ENG-2317. How to run: see README in benchmark-lab/runner/allocator_epoch_replayer/ (quickstart, --golden, --long-run). Merge plan: squash merge after two approvals.
